items.question: What percentage of the yearly rental charges is the Dubai Municipality housing fee that tenants must pay?
items.gold: 5 per cent of the yearly rental charges.
items.fact: Dubai housing fee is 5 percent of yearly rent

items.question: What identification documents and cheques must a tenant provide to conclude a lease contract with a landlord or real estate agent in the UAE?
items.gold: A copy of the passport, a valid residence visa, Emirates ID, and post-dated cheques covering the agreed lease period.
items.fact: Tenant lease documents: passport, residence visa, Emirates ID, cheques
